subject: Post-demo: model benchmarks, prompt harvest & redaction checklist
body:
From: Alex Romero <alex@firmcare.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sen <priya@firmcare.io>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up & next steps after today's demo

Thanks again for the deep dive today, Irene — the demo was helpful and the latency/cost numbers looked promising. A few follow-ups from our side so we can scope a short pilot: 

- Can you share recommended model variants for (1) triage classification (short prompts) and (2) discharge summary generation (longer context)?
- We need a benchmark CSV with token-level latency and cost for 2k/10k token scenarios.
- We will gather 200 sample prompts — can you confirm redaction guidance for PHI before we upload?

Also copying Priya, who will own compliance. Can you loop in the engineering contact if there are any constraints on file formats?

Cheers,
Alex Romero
Product Lead, FirmCare Health
---

On Mon, 21 Jun 2027 at 09:08, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Alex Romero <alex@firmcare.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Sen <priya@firmcare.io>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & next steps after today's demo

Hi Alex — great to meet you both. Quick recap + what we'll deliver by EOD Thursday: 

1) Model recommendations (short list):
   - Triage classification (low-latency): redwood/llama3-13b-int8 (quantized) — good balance of latency and accuracy for short prompts.
   - Discharge summary (long context, quality-focused): redwood/longform-7b-qlora or redwood/mpt-30b-enc-long-context (if you need richer clinical language).

2) Benchmarks: We'll attach a CSV with token-level latency, cost-per-1k-tokens, and p50/p95 latency for 2k and 10k token runs across both suggested variants and a fallback cheaper variant. See attached redwood-benchmarks-20270620.csv.

3) Prompt set collection + redaction guidance: Please provide sample prompts as CSV or JSONL. Before you upload customer data, remove/replace these fields: patient_name, MRN, SSN, DOB, full_address, and any free-text that contains explicit PHI. If you need a redaction template, we'll include a one-page checklist.

4) Eval plan & regression concerns: We'll run an initial quality baseline (10 curated test cases + 50 random samples from your corpus) and set up regression alerts in Redwood Optimize if accuracy or hallucination rate deviates by >5% from baseline.

Action items for FirmCare:
- Share 200 sample prompts (CSV) and mark any that are "sensitive" so we can exclude from public logging.
- Share your security questionnaire or tell us which fields you'd like redacted before upload.

Action items for Redwood:
- Attach benchmark CSV and short redaction checklist.
- Propose pilot scope (2-week pilot, 1 model variant in production with fallback).

I'll also loop Ben and Marissa for contract and eval support. 

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
---

On Tue, 22 Jun 2027 at 11:15, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Alex Romero <alex@firmcare.io>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Sen <priya@firmcare.io>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & next steps after today's demo

Alex — quick note from pricing/ops perspective: for the pilot we can offer a capped usage credit of $2,000 (applies to hosted API usage only) and standard data terms. If FirmCare needs a dedicated pool for isolation during the pilot, we can scope that but it will change pricing. 

Marissa — can you own the eval dashboard setup and the regression alert thresholds? We'll need the HubSpot deal updated (FCH-2027-78).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
---

On Thu, 24 Jun 2027 at 10:05, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Alex Romero <alex@firmcare.io>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Sen <priya@firmcare.io>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & next steps after today's demo

Alex & Priya — attaching the benchmark CSV and a short redaction checklist (see attachments). Summary of what's attached: 

- redwood-benchmarks-20270620.csv — p50/p95 token latency and cost-per-1k for recommended variants; includes an extra column with expected batch sizes for 95% of requests.
- firmcare_sample_prompts.csv — please mark the "SENSITIVE" column for any rows that contain PHI. We'll treat marked rows as private and exclude them from shared logs.
- firmcare_security_requirements.pdf — your security contact indicated they'd prefer file-based evidence; this is the checklist we use to confirm data handling steps during pilots.

Next steps / proposed timeline:
- Thu (today): FirmCare uploads sample_prompts.csv with SENSITIVE flags.
- Mon: Redwood runs internal redaction check, returns a redacted sample set and the baseline eval results for 10 curated cases.
- Following Tue: Kick off 2-week pilot; we'll enable regression alerts on Redwood Optimize and provide a weekly quality report.

If you want us to accept files via secure SFTP instead of Drive, tell us and we'll provide credentials. 

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior PM, Evals & Customer Success, Redwood Inference

- redwood-benchmarks-20270620.csv (CSV)
- firmcare_sample_prompts.csv (CSV)
